name: Zephyr Presrv™ 15" 3.4 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Built In Beverage Center
shortDescription: Always have drinks on hand for guests — or just the family — with our Presrv™ 15” Beverage Cooler. Features such as a Full-Extension Wood Rack, PreciseTemp™ temperature control for maintaining accurate temperatures and Active Cooling Technology to ensure even cooling all add up to the beverage cooler of your dreams.

features.text: New enhancements include mood-setting LED light strips in three colors and four light levels and an updated kickplate with lock.
Full-Extension Black Wood Racks rest on stainless steel ball bearing glides
Active Cooling Technology which is an on-board computer that controls the active cooling fans to provide temperature stability and even cooling.
PreciseTemp™ features multiple internal sensors help maintain accurate temperatures
The Zero-Clearance Door Hinge allows installation adjacent to a cabinet without the cooler door hitting the cabinet.
3-Color LED is available in Cloud White, Deep Blue and Amber
Transparent-Gray Glass Shelves include airflow openings to keep temperatures even throughout the cooler
Vibration Dampening System allow noise and vibration to be reduced to minimize wine disturbance
Dual-Pane, Low-e, Argon-Filled Glass Door provide insulation to reduce heat exchange. A Low-e coating helps reduce UV and infrared light that passes through the glass door.
